Name: Bun's Dateable (and Marry) Caroline Portraits
Author: Buncisoup
Description:
Replaces Jodi's portrait from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15532]Dateable (and Marry) Caroline[/url] mod to fit with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16868]Bun's NPC Portrait[/url].
I only switch Caroline's portrait into the new sprites, all the content stays within the base mod.

[size=4][b]Installation
[/b][/size][spoiler]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7721][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15532]Dateable (and Marry) Caroline[/url]﻿ and its dependencies
[*]Extract '[i]Bun's Dateable Caroline Portrait[/i]' into '[i]Mods[/i]' folder
There will be two folder :
 -  '[i]Bun's [i]Dateable Caroline[/i] Portrait[/i]' for manifest file, and
﻿ -  '[i][CP] [i]Dateable Caroline[/i][/i]' folder that will replace Dateable Caroline's original portraits with Bun's portraits
Let the files overwrite
[*]Run the game by running the SMAPI.exe
[/list]
If you find a bug, please let me know ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi log[/url] would be helpful)

To uninstall this mod, simply remove [i]'[/i][i]Bun's [i]Dateable Caroline[/i] Portrait[/i]' folder from [i]'Mods'[/i] folder.
Reinstall Dateable Caroline to get the original portraits fom the mod.
[/spoiler]

[i]Thank you SYmokarin and Nachona for making Datable Jodi as the base mod and letting me do this[/i]
